# Jeanette Silvas

Design engineer based in Austin. Working across Figma and React — currently at Amazon on the Product Image Experience team.

## About

I work on both sides of the design-engineering gap. At Amazon that's meant owning high-impact features end-to-end: Figma explorations, frontend spec, and React + TypeScript implementation.

Background: AWS, InVision, Expedia. Degree in Bioengineering from Texas A&M.

- **Bulk Image Upload** (Amazon, 2025) — Redesigned the bulk image upload flow. Reduced errors by 34%, doubled completion rate, cut support tickets by 20%.
- **Image Manager** (Amazon, 2026) — Case study in progress.
- **Craft Log** (Personal, 2026) — Live app at craftlog.app.
